pageDescription: Send this organization's order and fulfillment notifications to a Telegram group.
noPermission: Only organization admins can configure notifications.

telegram.title: Telegram Integration
telegram.description: New orders (from manual and automatic sync), successful fulfillments and confirmed cancellations are sent to this chat.
telegram.botTokenHint: Create a bot with @BotFather and paste its token here.
telegram.botTokenKeepHint: Leave empty to keep the saved token. The token is never shown again.
telegram.chatIdHint: Group / channel ID (e.g. -1001234567890) or @channelusername. Add the bot to the group first.

testError.TELEGRAM_CHAT_NOT_FOUND: Chat not found — check the Chat ID and that the bot is in the group.
testError.TELEGRAM_FORBIDDEN: The bot is not allowed to post in this chat.
testError.TELEGRAM_RATE_LIMITED: Telegram is rate limiting this bot — try again shortly.
testError.TELEGRAM_SERVER_ERROR: Telegram is having problems — try again shortly.
testError.TELEGRAM_NETWORK_ERROR: Cannot reach Telegram from the server.
testError.TELEGRAM_TIMEOUT: Telegram did not respond in time.

telegram.removeConfirm: The saved Bot Token and Chat ID are removed and no more notifications are sent.
telegram.encryptionMissing: The server has no NOTIFICATION_ENCRYPTION_KEY yet, so the Bot Token cannot be stored. Contact your system administrator.

error.tokenFormat: The token must look like <bot id>:<secret> from @BotFather.

events.title: Recent notifications
events.description: Delivery status of each notification — use it to find configuration problems.

preferences.title: Notification types
preferences.description: Choose which events this organization receives on Telegram. Applies to this organization only.
preferences.telegramNotReady: Telegram is not configured or is disabled — your choice is saved and applies once Telegram is enabled.

newOrder.label: New Order
newOrder.hint: Receive a notification when a new TikTok order is detected during sync (manual or automatic).

fulfillment.label: Fulfill
fulfillment.hint: Receive a notification when an order is fulfilled or a fulfillment is cancelled.
